req.title: Return 404 for unknown squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player has the requested squad number.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-005 requires HTTP 404 when no player has the requested squad number. The pre-loaded DB has squad numbers 1-26. Tests must cover: (1) a clearly non-existent squad number (EP/NEG), (2) the boundary just above the highest known squad number (BVA: 27 = 26+1), (3) the boundary just below the lowest known squad number (BVA: 0 = 1-1), (4) a known-existing squad number to confirm 200 is NOT returned for 404 path (DT positive control), and (5) a very large squad number to confirm the 404 path is not gated by magnitude (NEG). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact status code 404 (catches 404->200, 404->400, 404->500 mutations), asserting the response body does NOT contain player data fields (catches mutations that return a body on 404), and asserting 200 for the positive control (catches mutations that flip the not-found branch).

tests.name: test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_returns_200
preconditions: DB contains exactly 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
trace: R-PLAYER-005: positive control — existing squad number must NOT return 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Reddy'
